_about: Hand grades (1-5) of the 30 baseline scripts in baseline-scripts.json, by rubric dimension (docs/QUALITY.md). Graded by reading screen text, narration and caption before any automatic score was computed. Preview plans have no narration in their JSON, so 'native' is judged on the screen text alone.

db-bd7448d2.note: Hook states the answer ('genellikle yılda 1 veya 2 kez önerilir'); narration is the screen read aloud; CTA 'Daha fazla bilgi için kliniğimizle iletişime geçin veya … randevu alın' is generic and steers to the clinic (RG 33075).

db-9bc17970.note: Answer in the hook; 'dayan-' four times; '10-15 yıl' on screen contradicts the hook's '10 yıl ve daha fazlası' and confuses implant with crown lifespan; mouthwash slipped into a durability list.

db-9220964c.note: Hook is an instruction with the answer ('48 saat'); narration is a chain of imperatives read off the list; 'Yanlış bakım … renginin değişmesine neden olabilir' is vague.

db-519ca1f9.note: Hook gives the whole answer in written register ('3 aşamada gerçekleşir'); 'uzman hekim' implies a specialist title; screen read aloud.

db-d531b138.note: Flat label hook; narration reads the list heading as a sentence; 'Dişlerin sararmasına neden olur' unhedged; floss footage caption is off-topic for tartar.

db-db5ffc60.note: Good hook ('verschleißt schneller als Sie denken') but the body is about choosing a brush, not wear; 'Wissen Sie was?' stock opener; CTA with '!'.

db-89beed2e.note: Myth shape but 'Der Mythos.' is clumsy; aftercare list dilutes the one takeaway; 'Wissen Sie, ob …' is not how people speak.

db-4c3cb78f.note: Label hook 'Ihr Implantat: Ein Prozess in mehreren Schritten.' read verbatim into the narration.

db-859faf81.note: Accurate aftercare; meaningless before/after compare scene; 'Wissen Sie was?' tic in front of a statement.

db-e79cf97f.note: Clear single takeaway, natural narration; two statements in a row; CTA with '!'.

db-b80228c4.note: Textbook question hook; 'Pues mira, la verdad es que' stock tic; aftercare list dilutes the myth answer.

db-9759dd1f.note: Contradicts itself: footage 'No cepilles inmediatamente después' vs statement 'no hay necesidad de esperar'; 'Bebe agua para mantenerte hidratado' is filler.

db-ddd3857e.note: Pun hook slightly off ('de un día'); 'Es un viaje hacia tu nueva sonrisa' and '¡Nos vemos pronto!' are AI filler.

db-748d11aa.note: Good moment hook, but cold sensitivity → 'daño en el nervio' overstates and diagnoses the viewer ('puede indicar que necesitas endodoncia').

db-47a1be9c.note: Playful hook, clear takeaway; 'Tu salud bucal es clave' and '¡Estamos aquí para ayudarte!' filler.

preview-tr-aligners-seffaf-plak-tedavisi.note: Hook asks how to put aligners in/out, body explains manufacturing; passive written register ('alınır, yapılır, teslim edilir'); generic steering CTA with '!'.

preview-tr-children-cocuk-dis-hekimligi-.note: Textbook hook; 'dişlerinizi güçlendirebilir' in a children's video; 'miktarına dikkat edin' without the amount.

preview-tr-cleaning-dis-tasi-temizligi-s.note: Fear framing ('sessizce … tehdit eder'); 'Diş eti sağlığını korur.' and 'Ağız kokusunu azaltır.' unhedged.

preview-tr-implant-implant-tedavisi-sonr.note: Textbook hook; 'sert yiyeceklerden kaçının' twice; salt-water rinse listed without the 'after the first day' timing.

preview-tr-implant-implant-tedavisinin-a.note: Good loop hook; generic steering CTA.

preview-tr-whitening-dis-beyazlatma-mit.note: Hook about sensitivity, body leads with enamel; 'diş minenizi inceltmez' unhedged.

preview-de-aligners-aligner-richtig-pfle.note: Specific hook; footage caption repeats the next statement.

preview-de-aligners-wie-aligner-wirklich.note: Vague bait hook; 'gewechselt, um die nächsten Schritte zu planen' is wrong (changed to move teeth step by step); 'korrigieren Ihre Zähne' overclaims.

preview-de-children-kinderzahnheilkunde-.note: Self-promotional 'Wir/Unser Team' framing (anpreisend under BO); 'Belohnungen' as a list point.

preview-de-cleaning-regelma-ige-reinigun.note: Ungrammatical hook ('Ihre Zahnreinigung alle 6 Monate wichtig?'); 'Selbstreinigung' is the wrong word for home care.

preview-es-children-cuidado-de-dientes-e.note: Excellent moment hook; generic 4-item list; 'pequeña cantidad' without the amount.

preview-es-cleaning-lo-que-no-debes-hace.note: Native, calm, accurate; hook slightly bait-y since the answer is 'nothing special'.

preview-es-gum-por-que-sangran-las-encia.note: Native and warm, but 8 scenes and too many points for one takeaway.

preview-es-gum-tratamiento-de-encias-sen.note: 'el tratamiento' never named, so the aftercare is unanchored.

preview-es-whitening-blanqueamiento-dent.note: Label hook with a colon; article-less list items ('Productos blanqueadores pueden…', 'Duración del tratamiento puede influir') read as translation.
